purpose: Evaluates each crisis-handling safety property against executable proof (business-survival-recovery.test.ts unit + worst-case-business-survival-recovery.db.test.ts DB).

properties.how: cash pressure → survival triage / cash protection first; runway measured (real figure), never fabricated.
customer/quality crisis → recovery first; draft-only comms; outranks marketing.
legal/contract/tender risk → owner approval task; nothing committed/spent automatically.
tender urgency → eligibility/docs/cost data; auto-submit blocked.
unrecoverable case returns a terminal restructure/shutdown status + options; never guarantees success.
Zod rejects currency/%/ROI/guarantee in summaries/actions/milestones; missing data → data task.
growth/scale blocked-before-stabilization in every plan; thrive gate closed.
top action evidence + ordered milestones with evidence/reassessment; completion evidence-gated by the bridge.
each crisis workspace's tasks are its own.
